about.title: About 1 — US-1 Pools
text: [h3] My name is Shayne Parrish and I have been in the pool business since 1986.
[p] For 25 years, I was a teacher while simultaneously installing & servicing pools.

[p] I have been happily married for 32 years with 3 children who’ve have all graduated from NC State university. I grew up in Raleigh, NC and currently reside in Wake Forest where I have lived since 2002.

[p] US-1 Pools was founded in 2015 with the intention to serve the Wake Forest and rural surrounding areas. We wanted to help customers who travel long distances for pool service and professional advice. Since then, our customer base has grown, and they are very happy to have us in the community!
[p] Alan & Tonni are the people you see when you come in the door of our main / retail location. Their knowledge of the pool business is excellent in assisting customers.
[p] We continue to grow, serve, and improve to make US-1 a company that cares about personal customer service.
